Title: Corporate Ascension

INT. CORPORATE OFFICE - DAY

The intern, JAMES, a wide-eyed, eager young man, enters the manager's office, RICHARD, a cold, calculating executive. Richard's office is adorned with awards, a testament to his success.

RICHARD
(Looking up from his desk, a slight smirk)
Ah, James. Welcome aboard. I've been looking forward to our meeting.

JAMES
(Nervously)
Thank you, Mr. Richard. I'm excited to learn from you.

RICHARD
(Leaning back in his chair, steepling his fingers)
I'm sure you are, James. I've seen a lot of eager young minds like yours come through these doors. But let me tell you something...

James swallows, his eyes wide with anticipation.

RICHARD
(Continuing)
The things you're about to encounter here are not for the faint of heart. This is a world where the weak are eaten by the strong.

James gulps, his confidence wavering.

RICHARD
(Smiling)
But don't worry, James. I'll help you navigate this jungle. I'll show you the ropes, teach you the tricks of the trade. But remember, this is a cutthroat world. And it's a world that usually doesn't have much patience for inexperience.

James nods, his eyes downcast.

RICHARD
(Leaning forward)
I want you to reflect on your limitations, James. Understand them, and then work tirelessly to overcome them. That's the only way you'll survive here.

James looks up, determination in his eyes.

JAMES
I understand, Mr. Richard. I'll do my best.

RICHARD
(Smirking)
I expect nothing less. Now, let's get to work.

As James leaves the office, Richard watches him go, a satisfied smile on his face. The intern's spirit is broken, but Richard knows he's just begun to mold him into the ruthless corporate warrior he needs.
